description: This file defines a class `Feed` within the `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension` namespace. The class is a controller for managing feed extensions in the OpenCart admin interface, including methods for listing, installing, uninstalling, and validating feed extensions.

classes.name: Feed
classes.description: Controller class for managing feed extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. Provides functionality to list, install, uninstall, and validate feed extensions, handling permissions and dynamically registering controllers and models associated with each extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of feed extensions available in the system.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles a list of available and installed feed extensions, including their statuses and control URLs, and renders the extension feed view.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to modify extensions, returning true if permitted, false otherwise.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a feed extension, including registration, permission assignment, and setup. Returns JSON response with success or error information.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a feed extension, including permission removal and cleanup. Returns JSON response with success or error information.
